prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2 by 2 square room-floor texture atlas for the playable Flooded Temple game. Input image is an ART DIRECTION reference only. Match its richly painted ancient carved blue-grey stone, wet cracked sandstone, amber torchlight and turquoise flooded ruin materials very closely. Output ONE square atlas made of exactly FOUR equally sized square tiles in a strict 2x2 grid, no padding, no captions. Each tile is a separate straight-on slightly elevated dungeon room floor, camera and scale identical, filling its entire square. Top left: warm cracked sandstone flagstones, small clay jars and a few coins tucked into lower corner. Top right: cool teal shallow water over cracked floor, a fragment of carved statue at an edge. Bottom left: neutral blue stone with fine glyph engravings, a small broken column and rubble tucked at bottom edge. Bottom right: amber-lit dusty stone floor with a small dark amphora at a corner. Centers must be open readable floor space for separate chest or lever overlays. High detail with convincing depth, not flat vector, faithful to reference game artwork. Recessed shadows at the edges but NO surrounding wall frame, NO fixed doors or passages, NO full blocking rubble, NO treasure chests, relics, levers, characters, arrows, route lines, lettering, labels or UI. These four tiles are interchangeable decoration and must not imply game topology. Orthographic aligned square floors, no skewed panels or gutters.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game prop sprite atlas for Flooded Temple. The input image is the approved STYLE reference only. Match its detailed semi-realistic painted gold, aged brass, carved turquoise stone, rich shadows, warm amber glints. Output ONE wide atlas with exactly EIGHT separate props in a strict 4 columns by 2 rows grid of equally sized SQUARE cells, no gutters, all on genuine transparent alpha. Every prop fits fully inside its own cell with at least 12 percent clear alpha margins on every side. Identical lighting and scale between corresponding state pairs. Top row left to right: 1 a CLOSED golden ancient treasure chest in three-quarter view; 2 the SAME chest OPEN, glowing gold coins inside, same base shape and position; 3 an upright brass lever with a red-brown handle mounted on a small heavy square stone plinth; 4 the SAME lever pulled to the right, same plinth and camera. Bottom row left to right: 5 ornate ancient gold SUN RELIC with bright turquoise jewel and radial sun rays on a small pedestal, like reference top-right room; 6 a weathered circular brass compass medallion lying flat with turquoise inlays, like reference floor compass; 7 a hanging forged bronze barred dungeon gate in a rectangular stone frame, straight-on; 8 a neatly coiled thick tan expedition rope with a brass hook. Each object isolated, full object visible, no cast floor plane outside the object, no big bloom outside margins, no backdrop, no shadows shared between cells, no letters, numbers, text, characters, arrows or UI. Luxurious tactile adventure game inventory art, not cartoon or vector.

conversion: Technical slicing of the generated 4x2 atlas into eight transparent WebP sprites, 6px separators excluded, all alpha preserved. Floor atlas resized to 1024 square WebP. No semantic repainting. The generated gate frame is alpha-trimmed for a nine-slice frame; a 25 by176 pixel vertical stone strip is extracted for live wall rendering. These are technical atlas slices, without semantic repainting.
